model: Adiabatic cycle-averaged vector eigenfields coupled to local populations and finite disk/plate assembly
limitations: Eigenfields are not prescribed Gaussian profiles, but are frozen during each fast optical cycle
Incoherent modal photon dynamics; coherent beating, phase locking and spatial hole-burning fringes are not solved
Gain guiding uses cycle-averaged gain; within-cycle transverse-mode changes need a future time-dependent field solver
Cold optical spectra and prescribed bonded-interface properties remain unchanged
One mode is the economical default, not proof that other modes are stable or suppressed
